//: Standard MCP client config (mcpServers map), mounted into the Hermes container at /opt/data/mcp.json. Hermes turns each configured server into a toolset named mcp-<server-name> (e.g. this 'github' entry becomes the 'mcp-github' toolset). NOTHING should ever grant the raw 'mcp-github' toolset wholesale to a bot profile — it includes merge_pull_request and other mutating tools. Bots get a hand-picked custom_toolsets subset instead; see config.yaml's custom_toolsets block and docs/architecture.md.
